mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, causal confirmation of a canonical ten-bar-surrounded pivot low or high on completed four-hour BTC auctions identifies a bar-count reversal; follow the reversal direction for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when a strict pivot low is confirmed; short when a strict pivot high is confirmed; ignore a bar classified as both
mechanism.why_distinct: PPHL confirms that a historical center bar is the unique low or high against ten completed bars on each side, delaying availability by ten four-hour bars. It is not a contemporaneous extreme, channel breakout, moving average, oscillator, volume, flow, OI, funding, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: confirmed swing extrema can separate reversal structure from noisy one-bar extremes, while completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation at confirmation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse, forty-hour-delayed strict bar-count reversal confirmations are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.candidate_center: the completed bar ending forty elapsed hours before confirmation
features.high_pivot: center high strictly exceeds highs of all ten earlier and ten later completed bars
features.low_pivot: center low strictly undercuts lows of all ten earlier and ten later completed bars
features.event: at current confirmation only, low pivot gives +1 and high pivot gives -1; Both and None give 0
features.causal_availability: no center classification is available before all ten right-side bars have completed
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed five-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive at confirmation time
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid confirmations, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.recursive_reset: 21-bar high/low windows reset after any invalid completed four-hour bar

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after the tenth right-side confirmation bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: official LEAN PPHL(10,10,100,strict) causal reversal confirmation under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no surrounding count, strictness, confirmation delay, Both handling, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: Pivot Points High/Low (Bar Count Reversals); QuantConnect LEAN canonical implementation
external_basis.fixed_definition: documented high and low surrounding counts 10, strict=true, 21-bar rolling windows, center index 10; pivot high requires every other high strictly lower, pivot low requires every other low strictly higher; confirmed only when the tenth right-side bar completes; lastStoredValues=100 is storage-only
external_basis.selection_use: official documented counts, strict comparisons, causal right-side confirmation, and published bar-count reversal interpretation only; no incidence or outcomes
